Devon (partnerships): Heads-up — ACME Reseller submitted a batch PO to Azure marketplace but the portal rejects it with a multi-signer/encoding error. Customer is on a tight go-live this week. :boom:
Hannah (finance): Ugh. Can you paste the rejection payload and the PO header? need vendor id + currency to route payment.
Devon (partnerships): Rejection from marketplace portal: 
```
<error code="PO_VALIDATION_FAIL">multiple_signers_not_allowed</error>
```
PO header looks like this: 
```
<PO>
  <VendorID>ACME-RESELLER</VendorID>
  <Signatures>
    <Sig>buyer-signer</Sig>
    <Sig>reseller-signer</Sig>
  </Signatures>
</PO>
```
Maya (partner-ops): Marketplace expects a single effective signer for 3P resellers; our PO normalizer usually consolidates but it only runs for CSV uploads. This is EDI/portal flow so it failed.
Ilya (eng - integrations): Quick fix would be a routing rule to map multi-signer -> consolidated-signer before hitting the portal. I can hack a transform in the connector but we need legal ok for changing signature semantics.
Luca (legal): We need the contract language to allow signature consolidation. If we auto-consolidate we should log an audit trail and surface original signers to the buyer and reseller.
Hannah (finance): Also need to confirm tax/jurisdiction doesn't change when we consolidate — sometimes reseller signer determines billing entity.
Marco (vendor success): ACME is panicking, their procurement team will not resend. They want a portal exception. Can we ask marketplace partner ops to allow this one-off?
Devon (partnerships): Filed for exception with Marketplace partner team — ticket #MP-84321. MarketplaceBot: "MP-84321: PO rejected (multiple_signers_not_allowed). SLA 48h."
Maya (partner-ops): Two paths: 1) request one-off portal exception (slow, manual) OR 2) implement transform + audit trail (fast internally, needs legal & finance signoff). Which do we want?
Luca (legal): I can draft an addendum clause for audit trail consent and vendor acknowledgement. Send me sample PO & reseller MSA reference.
Hannah (finance): I'll confirm whether billing entity would change; pinging accounting ops.
Ilya (eng - integrations): If we go transform route I can target a hotfix to the EDI adapter and add a header X-Original-Signers with JSON list. Minimal change surface. ETA 3 business days.
Devon (partnerships): For go-live this week we need a short-term manual exception + parallel engineering work. Marco, can you push ACME to accept a temporary manual override?
Marco (vendor success): On it. Emailing ACME procurement now and copying marketplace partner ops. Will ask them to accept the override and confirm they won't re-upload. :crossed_fingers:
Maya (partner-ops): I'll escalate MP-84321 and request expedited review citing go-live. Also start the change request for the EDI transform.
Devon (partnerships): Thanks team. Action items: Marco -> secure buyer acceptance; Maya -> escalate exception & open engineering change; Ilya -> prep transform PR; Luca -> draft addendum; Hannah -> confirm billing impact. I'll follow up in 6 hours. :thumbsup:
